name: Simmer
summary: A biryani recipe card: scale the servings, tick ingredients, and each step adds a layer to the pot
about: A recipe card with a see-through pot drawn in SVG. Change the servings and every amount slides to its new value, rounded to friendly fractions like ¾ cup. Tick ingredients as you gather them, then switch to Steps: each step you finish drops its layer into the pot, spiced chicken, rice, fried onions and herbs, saffron rice, while the flame flickers and bubbles rise. The last step drops the lid, seals it and turns the flame low, then the pot rattles and rice confetti flies.
how: Use minus and plus next to Servings: each amount slides up to its new value.
Tap ingredients to tick them off; the bar fills and cheers when you have everything.
Open Steps and tick each one: its layer falls into the pot and stacks in recipe order.
Steps with a time have a timer chip: tap to start a real countdown, tap again to pause.
Finish the last step to seal the lid, see Ready to serve and the confetti; untick a step to lift its layer out.
